title: {Syn} Attention Is All You Need Changed the Default Architecture
content:
The 2017 Transformer paper replaced recurrent sequence processing with attention-based layers and parallel training. Its title, Attention Is All You Need, aged unusually well.

Transformers now sit behind many language, vision, audio, and multimodal systems because attention makes long-range interactions easier to model at scale.

Why it matters: ai papers keeps producing ideas that are simple enough to state and strong enough to build with.
